name: Iroha Kaede
source:
An energetic, honest and heroic girl who wears animal ears and tail as accessories. She has a pet [url=http://vndb.org/c11347]tanuki[/url] that can understand human language.
At the beginning of the game she gets in trouble with three boys and Soujirou tries to resolve it.
Also, she often carries around two plungers for some reason.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maple_Colors_2]Wikipedia[/url] and roughly translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=559385]Getchu[/url].]
